_meta.title: Comparison & Ablation Test Plan — alternatives drawn only from the knowledge base
_meta.purpose: Each test varies ONE documented component of a base strategy across alternatives that the knowledge base itself documents (or removes a component whose necessity the knowledge base asserts). No alternative introduces outside methodology. Every test is a Claim-type-B research operationalisation (ADV-M18-R01) and must follow the protocol: define rules -> label in-sample -> measure -> freeze -> out-of-sample -> freeze -> forward (ADV-M18-R05).
metrics_for_every_test: expectancy = Win% x AvgWin - Loss% x AvgLoss
maximum drawdown under the sizing rule
_meta.robustness_requirement: Repeat across instruments, years, volatility regimes, and small perturbations of labeling thresholds (ADV-M18-R06); sample must span multiple regimes (ADV-M18-R03).
_meta.reporting_requirement: ADV-M18-R07 — exact rules, instrument/timeframe/period/N, IS/OOS/forward separately, all metrics, rule-change log, and the statement that results describe the operationalisation, not ICT doctrine.
_meta.look_ahead_control: ADV-M18-R04 — every label computable at decision time; walk-forward labeling preferred.

tests.name: Stop / trade-invalidation placement

tests.kb_claim_under_test: Stops inside the array are 'too tight' (INT-M12-R02); a too-wide stop relative to first target means the trade is not worth taking (ADV-M17-R01). Test how each logical stop affects win rate vs R.

tests.name: Target / exit policy

arms.rule: Single target at the nearest opposing pool (displacement high/low)

tests.notes: Partial fraction is unspecified (ADV-M16-R06 'e.g. 50%'); test the researcher-frozen value and a perturbation.
